citation: Randle, Oliet and Renaud (1991), British Journal of Pharmacology 103, 1795–1801
locator: Methods on pp. 1795–1796 and Results on p. 1796, group means plotted in Fig. 3a.
observable: Reversal of the current induced by 100 µM cromakalim in whole-cell recordings from adult guinea-pig ventricular myocytes. Group means include cells with a clear reversal. Errors are SEM.
exchange: KCl replaces NaCl mole for mole. Other bath constituents were fixed, including MgCl₂ 1, CaCl₂ 1.8, NaH₂PO₄ 0.33, HEPES 10 and glucose 10 mM. Bath pH was 7.35. The paper reports at most 1 mV junction-potential variation with solution changes.
intracellular: Pipette KCl was 140 mM with about 3 mM KOH added for pH. The prediction for a voltage difference cancels the fixed intracellular K activity.
